testimonials.content: Booked a week in Aqaba through Beytak and the whole thing took ten minutes. The owner confirmed the same evening and the phone number was there as soon as the booking went through. No agency, no commission, no arguing over the deposit.

I have four properties listed here. What I actually needed was somewhere the dates could not be double booked, and that is what I got. A request comes in, I confirm it, and the calendar takes care of itself. The subscription pays for itself in one booking.

Finding an unfurnished flat in Amman usually means calling twenty numbers off a Facebook group. Here the area, the floor and whether it came furnished were on the listing before I called, so I only rang about places that actually suited me.
Rented a village house in Jerash for six months. Paid half up front in cash and the payment was logged on the booking, which meant there was no disagreement later about what had been handed over.

Booked a house in Shafa Badran for six months. Straightforward to use, though I would like to see the dates that are already taken before I pick mine rather than finding out when the request is refused.
Listed two apartments in Jabal Al Hussain last week. Uploading the photos was simple enough. Still waiting for my subscription payment to be confirmed before I can add the third.
Call me for the best apartments in Amman with cheap discount prices, all areas available, best offer guaranteed.
